classification.difficultyReason: Choose a rectangular decomposition of the L-shaped deck and recognise that one outer length includes x, avoiding omission or double-counting of the corner. Substitute the supplied area into the resulting expression, factorise the quadratic and retain the positive width.

content.prompt: A timber deck is built at the back of a house, as shown in the diagram. The measurements along the existing walls are 3 m and 4 m, as shown. The width of the deck is $x$ metres, as shown.

spec.description: An L-shaped deck adjoining an open house outline. Retains Deck and House labels, the inner 3 m vertical wall, the inner 4 m horizontal wall and both perpendicular width arrows labelled x m. Decorative purple fill is omitted under house style; ordinary strokes and labels are black.
spec.mathematics: The deck comprises a vertical rectangle of dimensions x by 3 and an upper rectangle of dimensions x by (x+4). Both strips have width x.
spec.answerVisibility: All diagram labels are permanent givens; no calculated area or width is shown.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Express the area $A\ \mathrm{m}^2$ of the deck in terms of $x$.

answer.worked:
Split the deck into a $3$ by $x$ rectangle and an $x$ by $(x+4)$ rectangle.

$$\begin{align*}A&=3x+x(x+4)\\A&=3x+x^2+4x\\A&=x^2+7x\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}x^2+7x&=30\\x^2+7x-30&=0\\(x+10)(x-3)&=0\end{align*}$$
Thus $x+10=0$ or $x-3=0$, giving $x=-10$ or $x=3$. Since the deck width is positive, $x=3\ \mathrm{m}$.

Check: $3^2+7\times3=30$.
